name: Live Demo Stream
description: Lets a spectator watch a player's view live: points an instance's sv_demoStream cvars at the central demo-stream relay and registers the instance with ql-stats-hub. The relay is one address for the whole cluster, but each game host runs a stunnel client that carries the stream to stats-hub over TLS with the hub's certificate pinned. Set the relay and stats-hub in Settings -> Live Demo Stream, turn on each host's Demo Stream Tunnel, then switch each instance on (and set its delay) from its Live Demo Stream menu entry. Needs a game server build that supports the sv_demoStream cvars.

host_tunnel.description: Installs stunnel on this host and pins the stats-hub TLS certificate, so instances stream to 127.0.0.1 and the tunnel carries it to the relay over TLS. Changing the port re-runs the setup; save each instance's Live Demo Stream panel again afterwards so its server.cfg picks up the new port. After the hub's certificate changes, save this panel again with Enabled to re-pin it. Saving with Enabled first asks stats-hub to let this host's IP through its firewall; turning the tunnel off takes the host out again unless the Telemetry Relay is still on. The status shows the hub firewall and whether the hub has a demo-stream link from this host.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Installs and starts the tunnel on this host.

fields.label: Local port
fields.description: Port the tunnel listens on at 127.0.0.1. Leave blank for 27999.

instance_stream.description: Streams this instance to stats-hub so spectators can watch it live. Switching it on or off applies the config and restarts the instance; changing only the delay does not.

fields.label: Stream this instance
fields.description: Needs the relay set in Settings and the Demo Stream Tunnel on this host.

fields.label: Delay (seconds)
fields.description: How far behind the live game viewers see it: 0 to 300, blank for the hub default.

settings.description: The relay every streaming instance connects to and the stats-hub that registers the streams. Independent of the telemetry-relay addon's stats-hub target.

fields.label: Relay host
fields.description: Hostname or IP the game servers can reach.

fields.label: Stats-hub URL
fields.description: Base URL the streams are registered against.

fields.label: Ingest token
fields.description: STATS_HUB_INGEST_TOKEN, not STATS_HUB_API_TOKEN. Never shown once saved; leave blank to keep the stored one.
